import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const b = await chromium.launch()

const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } })
const p = await ctx.newPage()
p.on('pageerror', (e) => out.push('ERR ' + e.message))
await p.goto('http://localhost:4988/?now=2026-08-31T15:20', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await p.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 2200)); await p.waitForTimeout(900)
await p.locator('[data-service="dental"] .linkish').click()
await p.waitForTimeout(1200)
out.push('after Request a slot -> select value: ' + await p.locator('#svc').inputValue())
out.push('focused element: ' + await p.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.id))
await p.locator('#name').fill('Rosa Alvarez')
await p.locator('#phone').fill('(555) 233-0119')
await p.keyboard.press('Tab')
await p.keyboard.press('Enter')
await p.waitForTimeout(600)
out.push('confirmation: ' + (await p.locator('[role="status"]').textContent()).trim())
await p.screenshot({ path: '.shots/d-booked.png' })

// --- hover states actually change something
await p.goto('http://localhost:4988/?now=2026-08-31T15:20', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await p.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 2200)); await p.waitForTimeout(900)
const row = p.locator('[data-service="primary"]')
const before = await row.evaluate((n) => getComputedStyle(n).backgroundColor)
await row.hover(); await p.waitForTimeout(300)
const after = await row.evaluate((n) => getComputedStyle(n).backgroundColor)
out.push(`service row hover: ${before} -> ${after} ${before !== after ? 'OK' : 'NO CHANGE'}`)
const btn = p.locator('.today__meter .btn--primary')
await p.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0)); await p.waitForTimeout(400)
const b1 = await btn.evaluate((n) => getComputedStyle(n).backgroundColor)
await btn.hover(); await p.waitForTimeout(300)
const b2 = await btn.evaluate((n) => getComputedStyle(n).backgroundColor)
out.push(`primary button hover: ${b1} -> ${b2} ${b1 !== b2 ? 'OK' : 'NO CHANGE'}`)
await p.keyboard.press('Tab')
out.push('first tab stop: ' + await p.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.className || document.activeElement.tagName))

// --- the reveal must finish while the region is on screen
const timings = await p.evaluate(async () => {
  const res = []
  for (const s of document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]')) {
    s.classList.remove('is-in')
  }
  window.scrollTo(0, 0)
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300))
  for (const s of document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]')) {
    const top = s.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY
    window.scrollTo(0, top - window.innerHeight * 0.5) // section centred-ish
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900))
    res.push(`${s.className.split(' ')[0]}: revealed=${s.classList.contains('is-in')} opacity=${getComputedStyle(s).opacity}`)
  }
  return res
})
out.push(...timings)
await ctx.close()

// --- reduced motion: everything must resolve, clock included
const ctx2 = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, reducedMotion: 'reduce' })
const p2 = await ctx2.newPage()
await p2.goto('http://localhost:4988/?now=2026-08-31T15:20', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await p2.waitForTimeout(700)
out.push('reduced: hidden regions = ' + await p2.evaluate(() =>
  [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]')].filter((n) => +getComputedStyle(n).opacity < 1).length))
await p2.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 700)); await p2.waitForTimeout(600)
out.push('reduced: sweep swept = ' + await p2.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('.clock__sweep')?.classList.contains('is-swept')))
out.push('reduced: elapsed width = ' + await p2.evaluate(() => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.clock__elapsed')).width))
await p2.screenshot({ path: '.shots/d-reduced.png' })
await ctx2.close()
await b.close()
console.log(out.join('\n'))
